important_recovery_history.lowercase_src_audit: GitHub contains both SRC and lowercase src. OpenVMS collapses them into one physical [.SRC] directory. M267 survivor audits must inspect both Git path families; native VAX SEARCH over [.SRC] remains authoritative for the physical tree.
important_recovery_history.final_restore_casefold: The first final restore driver used VMS git diff output, which uppercased mixed-case Git paths. Exact lowercase Git spellings were then restored explicitly; generic namespace SEARCH became clean.
important_recovery_history.symbol_index_restore: SRC/SYMBOL_INDEX.C failed RMS blob-size verification; its sole M267 comment token was patched locally to match GitHub, while generated OVMS_AGENT_SYMBOLS.DAT was deleted as intended.
important_recovery_history.goal_guard_self_guard: Final sweep accidentally changed an OPENAI_INTERNAL_H compatibility test in LLM_PROMPTS.H into a test of LLM_PROMPTS_H itself, making LLM_GOAL_GUARD.INC unconditional. Corrected at 7fcc678e.
important_recovery_history.lesson: Never retire compatibility or namespace names from stale search alone; use exact branch-live GitHub audit plus physical VAX SEARCH/build acceptance.
